Lena Morris: quick heads-up — we need a concise outbound update for customers impacted by yesterday's routing fallback. I uploaded the affected account list to the doc.
Darren Cho: noted. do we have legal guidance on compensation language? we should avoid definitive SLA guarantees.
Priya Patel: suggest tiered goodwill credits + an offer for a 1:1 enablement session. conservative amounts: 10% / 5% / enablement-only depending on severity. :thumbsup:
Tomás Rivera: can we define severity buckets? proposed: P1 (>=30m significant errors), P2 (repeated 5–30m), P3 (single short spike). credits 10/5/offer respectively.
Lena Morris: good. doc already flags each account with a severity marker. Anita, can billing process these ranges?
Anita Singh: billing OK with ranges. need csv with account id, contract tier, and billing contact by EOD to queue credits for next cycle.
Priya Patel: drafting the external note now. keeping it short/transparent. paste below for edits: 

Priya Patel: ```
Hi <Customer>,

Were reaching out about an incident on <date> that affected inference routing for some requests. You may have observed increased latency or transient 5xx responses during a limited window. Our engineers implemented a routing adjustment and validated model fallbacks to restore normal service.

What happened:
- Root cause: a rare interaction between routing heuristics and a KV cache eviction pattern causing transient misrouted requests.
- Immediate fixes: routing policy tweak and cache hardening deployed.
- Next steps: a long-term patch is being developed; estimated ETA ~2 weeks.
- Impact: brief degraded responses for a subset of traffic; no customer data exposure.

Our remediation and offer:
- Compensation: a billing credit of 10% (P1) / 5% (P2) / complimentary enablement session (P3) will be applied where applicable.
- Enablement: complimentary 30-min session with a solutions engineer to review high-throughput best practices.

If you'd like a tailored follow-up, reply and we'll schedule.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

Darren Cho: swap placeholders with the tiered amounts and add link to status page + opt-out for call scheduling. some customers prefer credits only.
Tomás Rivera: add a sentence about improved monitoring and that were tracking signals; ETA note ok.
Anita Singh: confirm credit phrase exactly: "A billing credit of 10% (P1) / 5% (P2) / a complimentary enablement session (P3) will be applied where applicable." billing needs the csv to apply credits.
Priya Patel: will ping legal for a quick review and update the template. aiming to send outbound 10:00 PT tomorrow after sign-off.
ops-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.docs/incident/1990011223-account-impact-list (shared with cs/sales/legal)
Lena Morris: ops, queue a targeted Intercom email and attach a short post-send survey to capture whether customers noticed impact and if the credit/offer is acceptable.
ops-bot: Email template queued in Intercom: Incident-1990011223-cs-template. Post-send survey draft: https://redwood.docs/surveys/1990011223-survey
Darren Cho: who handles scheduling for the 1:1s? SEs or enablement?
Priya Patel: I will coordinate with the SE team and include a Calendly link in the email for easy booking.
Tomás Rivera: flagging renewal-risk accounts in the doc — Lena, can CS lead personal outreach for the top 10 at-risk customers? I can provide tech notes for those conversations.
Lena Morris: yes, I'll take the top 10. Priya, include a personalized outreach template for renewals.
Anita Singh: note to customers that credits may take one invoice cycle to appear. include that in the outbound.
Priya Patel: final send checklist: updated draft (done), legal review (requested), billing CSV (Anita), top-10 owners assigned (Lena), survey link added (ops). target send 10:00 PT.
Lena Morris: please capture all customer replies in the doc thread and tag me for sentiment tracking and churn-risk escalation.
Darren Cho: will monitor replies and escalate any renewal concerns.
ops-bot: Reminder set: send outbound at 10:00 PT 1990013200.
Priya Patel: sending to legal now; will post the approved final copy here when received.
Lena Morris: appreciate quick turnaround, team. :pray:
